text:
sara_sales: Heads-up — AcmePay POC is blocked on legal signoff. They flagged our IP/data transfer clause and want KMS BYO details + egress limits before exec review. Need owners and ETA. @tom_eng can we support BYO KMS for a 2-week POC?

 tom_eng: short answer: yes for POC, but need key rotation window clarified. will check infra constraints and put numbers.

 ali_sec: I can take the security questionnaire. Can someone drop the latest SQA link and the customer's redlines?

 sara_sales: attaching customer's redlines below (copied from email). Also they asked for throughput/egress estimate for 100k tokens/day.

 julie_ps: onboarding + PS can support a 2-week private deployment plan. need final list of IP clauses to route to legal.

 marcus_gtm: FYI, exec wants signoff Friday. If legal can't commit, we escalate to exec bridge Tue. I'll join if needed. :eyes:

 tom_eng: quick numbers: with Dedicated 1xA100 (nv4) we can handle 100k tokens/day with p95 latency ~120ms if batching small. Egress estimate ~120GB/day (model + responses). I'll post a short math snippet in a sec.

 ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: #acmepay-poc 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC — invite sent to sara_sales, tom_eng, ali_sec, julie_ps, legal@redwood.

 sara_sales: thanks — can legal triage the IP redline thread and confirm whether we offer a one-way license vs transfer? @marcus_gtm

 ali_sec: started the SQA, requesting SOC2 artifact for infra. Also need clar on BYO KMS key share model (who holds wrapping key).

 tom_eng: quick calc:
 ```
 100k tokens/day * avg response payload ~= 120GB/day (includes model response + metadata)
 Tune batching to keep p95 < 200ms.
 ```
 Numbers rough — will validate with perf team.

 marcus_gtm: Legal to confirm license stance. If they demand transfer we need exec-level approval. Let's aim to have legal response by Wed EOD. If no, escalate Wed morning.

 julie_ps: I'll prep a short runbook for a 2-week private POC and the checklist for KMS onboarding (PKCS11/HSM notes).

 sara_sales: perfect. I'll consolidate action items and update this thread after meeting. :thumbsup:
